description: This file defines the JobCategory entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models a job category with 'id' and 'name' properties and includes getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: JobCategory
classes.description: Entity class representing a job category in the HRM system with ORM mappings, including properties for 'id' and 'name'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the job category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the job category.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job category.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job category.
